summary: Plumas County, CA Forest Service lookout: first built 1912, replaced 1952-53, last staffing notice 1959; reported vandalized 2012, removed 2014-2017; a repeater vault stands on the site.

facts.design: California Region 5 BC-1401 design (a revision of the BC-301) on a 9-foot block tower
facts.status_note: Removed between 2014 and 2017; a repeater vault now occupies the site

resolved_conflicts.field: construction year of the last building
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1953. A September 1952 newspaper item describes the new building as under construction, and Peakbagging gives 1952. The record keeps 1953 from the register and notes the other dates.

The register says a Plan 4AR structure replaced the original in 1923. A 1952 newspaper item says the first building was reconstructed in 1920. Both are recorded and the disagreement is stated in the story.

notes_for_editor: No source describes public access, so access is omitted. The FFLOS page cites NHLR US 1338, CA 161 for this site, while the firelookout.org list shows NHLR US 1367, CA 190 for a Kettle Rock in Plumas; unresolved. The NHLR page for this site was not in the cache (404). The OpenStreetMap way 864276937 tags a lookout tower but gives no current status, so it was not used. Staffing events are a selection from the 1922-1959 notices (1926 Frank Bare, 1927 Robert Thompson and 1944 Gene Leichter omitted). Ready for review; the 1952/1953 and 1920/1923 disagreements are stated in the story.
